product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform for enterprise teams that captures customer behavior across digital experiences and helps them understand and improve customer journeys.
product_one_liner.notes: The platform page describes Quantum Metric as a digital analytics platform, while the pricing page says it serves enterprises across varied teams and use cases.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page describing enterprise pricing and inviting prospective customers to contact sales; a public page counts even without listed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer-story pages name Lululemon and Ashley Furniture as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer-story page names Lululemon. | named_customers.1: The customer-story page names Ashley Furniture.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists its size as 201–500 employees. The company story separately says 500+ employees, so the profile's explicit band is used with some uncertainty.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies its headquarters as Colorado Springs, Colorado. | hq_country: The company-location record identifies the country as the United States and the locality as Colorado Springs, CO.

founded_year.notes: The company story states that Mario Ciabarra and David Wang founded Quantum Metric in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents posts in general-interest, perspectives, and product categories. The plausible post about building Felix is authored by Jake Canaan, but the post is not a concrete engineering implementation write-up. The available evidence does not establish two engineering/technical posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The publicly accessible Quantum Metric University site lists multiple product guides, including Alerts, Dashboards, and Events & Errors.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current job listings show roles such as Customer Success Engineer and Account Executive, and the current list contains no title matching the specified AI, ML, or data-science role categories.

model_provider.notes: The product announcement explicitly says Felix Agentic leverages Gemini models.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page names SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 and says the company complies with GDPR. A separate company page describes it as HIPAA-ready and SOC 2 Type II certified; HIPAA is qualified as readiness rather than certification. | compliance_certs.0: The security page names SOC 2 in its SOC2 + HITRUST attestation statement. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly says Quantum Metric is ISO/IEC 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.2: The page says the company complies with global privacy standards such as GDPR. | compliance_certs.3: The company describes itself as HIPAA-ready; this is a readiness claim, not a statement that it is HIPAA-certified.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding record labels the latest round Series B. | funding_date: The funding record dates the most recent round to January 2021 (specifically January 7, 2021), so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2021-01. | funding_amount_usd: The funding record identifies the latest round as a $200 million Series B in January 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: Reuters dates the $200 million round to January 7, 2021, and the funding-history record identifies it as the most recent round. It predates the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Account Executive posting shows the company is hiring for a qualifying account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced its Summer 2026 launch, dated July 16, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated executive-transition report says Chief Marketing Officer Efrat Ravid left the company on April 14, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: An Enterprise Account Executive posting names Salesforce as an example of a CRM system. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job post explicitly names Salesforce as an example of a CRM system.
